label: install-git-hooks.sh --status SHADOWED verdict is correct but the stated mechanism is wrong and the count is 6 not 7: the installed hooks are absolute symlinks into .opencode/scripts/git-hooks, and resolve_target takes readlink's absolute value and skips the dirname branch entirely, so it follows ZERO hops and compares two spellings of one file; the message 'resolves outside this checkout' is false for all six. .opencode/scripts is itself a symlink to ../.skilled/scripts, which is why the spellings meet. prepare-commit-msg prints (not installed), so earlier iterations' count of 7 measured a different link set. A fix aimed at hop-following would not close this.

label: The Commit-Id stamper is shipped but not installed: .skilled/scripts/git-hooks/prepare-commit-msg is 15,240 B and the installer's copy loop would install it, but .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg does not exist while the commit-msg gate that requires its trailer does. Every commit in this checkout therefore needs the trailer written by hand, which is the concrete reason the hook accept/reject question returns the same answer on every attempt. The shipped roster is complete, so this is a stale local link set that --status reports correctly, not a shipped defect.

v4.0.0.5, v4.0.0.6 and v4.0.0.7 carry no finding in this child and none is even named inside a finding label, yet all three changed in-scope surfaces: .5 adds /doctor:update check, a read-only layout report inside the audited doctor command; .6 changes the code agents' reporting and the repository rules, which is .skilled/agents, the runtime mirrors and .skilled/repo-rules; .7 adds the CI routing-drift gate and removes two retired deep-loop modes from every runtime's agent directory, which is .github/workflows and the mirrors. git rev-parse v4.0.0.4-v4.0.0.8 returns the single commit 4d8f403355, so per-release attribution is impossible by diff. Record them as unattributed, not as verified unchanged: absence of findings is not cleanliness, and those surfaces were never read against these three notes.

label: The delta stream carries a severity outside the run's own vocabulary: f-iter014-004 is recorded at P3, while the contract allows P0, P1 and P2 only, so a consumer bucketing by severity drops or mis-orders it. The underlying drift finding is sound (three copies of 'use only <tree>/agents/*.md as the canonical runtime path reference' with three different referents, invisible to a normaliser that folds .skilled|opencode|claude|pi into one token before comparing) and reads as P2. This is record hygiene in the research artifact, not in the repository, and it makes this child's P1 count a lower bound rather than an exact figure.

All six confirmed P1 repros reproduced at HEAD with recorded command, key output line and exit code. Four stand as previously stated (symlink-engine exit 0 on source-missing, checkHooks resolving the global hooksPath, 1 of 5 sk-git suites in CI, 4 of 7 runtime trees plus an inert opencode row in the mirror roster). Two needed correction: the SHADOWED count is 6 not 7 and the mechanism is zero hops on an absolute link (f-iter021-001), and the Commit-Id stamper is absent from .git/hooks while its gate is present (f-iter021-002).

Finding density per defect family across 20 delta files: sk-git suites 7 records, symlink-engine 11, agents-md 6, RUNTIME_MIRRORS 7, checkHooks 2, SHADOWED 1. The four P1s that one YAML edit closes are four restatements, not four independent defects, which is why rank 1 in f-iter021-003 is four lines rather than a programme of work.
